entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Give unto the LORD, O you mighty ones, Give unto the LORD glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Give unto the LORD the glory due to His name; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] over the waters; The God of glory thunders; The LORD [is] over many waters.

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] powerful; The voice of the LORD [is] full of majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars, Yes, the LORD splinters the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: He makes them also skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: The voice of the LORD divides the flames of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; The LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: The voice of the LORD makes the deer give birth, And strips the forests bare; And in His temple everyone says, "Glory!"

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: The LORD sat [enthroned] at the Flood, And the LORD sits as King forever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: The LORD will give strength to His people; The LORD will bless His people with peace.
